name: reading
description: Reading a review in Interactive mode. A long review folds to three lines behind Read more, and Show less folds it again. In French, PlayerVox answers the translations: a translated review is marked, Show original shows its untranslated text and Show translation comes back. A review hidden by the community shows no text until Show review. The choices stay through a new revision of the same page and start again on another page; Passive mode has no button.

items.author: Mira_Quill
items.text: The co-op campaign is the best puzzle design I have played in years. Every chamber teaches one idea, then twists it twice before letting you go, and the writing never gets in the way of the thinking. My only complaint is the loading between chambers.

items.author: Mira_Quill
items.text: La campagne en coopération est la meilleure conception de puzzles à laquelle j’ai joué depuis des années. Chaque salle enseigne une idée, puis la retourne deux fois avant de vous laisser partir, et l’écriture ne gêne jamais la réflexion. Mon seul reproche : les chargements entre les salles.
